newsitem.title: JAPAN: Seibu Oil completes gas oil desulphuriser.
newsitem.headline: Seibu Oil completes gas oil desulphuriser.

text.p: Seibu Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had completed construction of a 30,000 barrel-per-day gas oil desulphuriser at its Yamaguchi refinery in southern Japan.
Commercial operation of the advanced desulphuriser, which lowers the sulphur content of gas oil to below 0.05 percent, is due to start around the second quarter of 1997, a company spokesman said.
The government plans to lower the maximum allowable sulphur content in gas oil to 0.05 percent in October 1997 from the current 0.2 percent.
